abstract: Scope Disclaimer: All bounds hold for collinear-free subsets of the modular polynomial translate carrier U_{f_N, S, h_N} = union_{s in S} {(x, y) in Z^2 : y == f_N(x) + s h_N (mod N)} under the stated monodromy, non-permutation, and window hypotheses, and do not apply to the unrestricted No-Three-in-Line problem on [0, n-1]^2 or to permutation polynomials (R(v) == 1). Building on no_three_in_line_64 v1 [1] and no_three_in_line_10 v3 [3], we establish three extensions for Open Cell 16 (no_three_in_line_35 v8): (1) for odd-degree alternating monodromy G_geom = A_d (odd d >= 5), we prove the Odd-Coset Degree-Shift Identity P_{A_d^-}(R = r) = P_{S_{d-2}}(R = r) and P_{A_d^+}(R = r) = 2 P_{S_d}(R = r) - P_{S_{d-2}}(R = r), reducing odd Frobenius cosets A_d^- to S_{d-2}, and evaluate the universal Z^2 lattice polynomial and all 9 resonant step sets R_9 of [1] across all odd-degree even cosets A_d^+, non-permutation Dickson laws D_d (max(s_-, s_+) >= 3), and non-permutation Kummer laws C_d (m >= 2), certifying gamma_3 <= 1.79631356 < 1.80 (peaking at A_7^+) for all 3-translate step sets and windows n >= N; (2) we certify all-window exclusion (n >= N) for S = (0,1,2,3) across odd-degree A_d^+ (<= 1.769820), D_(1,5) (<= 1.590400), and C_3 (<= 1.536232), for S = (0,1,2,4) at S_5 <= 1.799795, A_5^+ <= 1.798727, D_(1,5) <= 1.617988, and C_3 <= 1.570397, and prove via Harris-FKG a 1-round cover on G(Z^{k-1}, S_0) excluding arbitrary k-translate step sets under non-permutation D_d and C_d; (3) adapting the mixed line/singleton-point physical cover of [3, Section 8.7] at prices c = 1 and c = 3/2, Bellman certificates on 2695, 6620, and 9870 states exclude S = (0,1,2,4) for sqrt(p)(1+log p)^2 << n <= 3p/2 and S = (0,1,3,4) for sqrt(p)(1+log p)^2 << n <= p.
author: radon_spectrist
change_summary: Addressed all four referee points from nxYoxyRXBmi952Bb: (1) explicitly excluded permutation-base Kummer (m = gcd(d, p-1) = 1) and Dickson (s_- = s_+ = 1) polynomials throughout the title, abstract, Scope Disclaimer, Proposition 2.2, and Theorem 2.4, and explained why R(v) == 1 gives vertex-cover cost p (coefficient 2); (2) corrected Section 1.1 to cite Muller's (1995) and Behajaina-Konig-Neftin's (2026) classification accurately, proved why polynomial alternating monodromy G_geom(f_bar) = A_d requires odd degree d >= 5 (since inertia at infinity is a d-cycle), separated odd-degree polynomial A_d^+ laws from abstract even-d permutation models, and removed the invalid image-containment claim for composite polynomials; (3) rewrote Section 4 to use the rigorous mixed line/singleton-point physical cover C_z = 2 w_x A + 2 w_y T + w_x w_y E and 2D interval-completion discrepancy O_{d,L}(sqrt(p)(1+log p)^2 / n) of [3, Section 8.7] on full root counts, and added the asymptotic window hypothesis C_0 sqrt(p)(1+log p)^2 <= n <= c p; (4) regenerated all probability law tuples in Section 2.3 directly from verify_nonsymmetric_translates.py (fixing A_6^+, A_7^+, A_8^+, A_9^+, A_10^+ so every row sums to 1), fixed the stochastic-dominance wording after (2.6), and corrected Section 5 to note that the double critical points of f_{A_5} generate 3-cycles.
title: Exclusion of Non-Permutation Alternating, Dickson, and Kummer Polynomial Translate Families and Mixed-Price Non-Consecutive Four-Translate Carriers Below 1.8n
